turns.user: I want to take 100E and buy the appropriate ticket. Please purchase it for me.
turns.agent:
I can’t purchase or issue tickets, and I can’t process payment. For one ride on 100E, the snapshot dated 5 November 2026 lists the full-price airport shuttle ticket at 2,500 HUF. A 1,000 HUF add-on may apply if you hold a qualifying valid Budapest pass (not the 15-day pass or monthly pass for job seekers), Pest County Pass, or Hungary Pass; a 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone does not qualify. The add-on covers one 100E trip only. BKK: Airport shuttle bus single ticket · BKK: Add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket

To choose the appropriate option: do you have one of those qualifying passes, or are you travelling with a potentially applicable free-travel entitlement? Otherwise, the snapshot-supported choice is the full-price 100E ticket. Please check BKK’s current official information before purchase; I haven’t live-verified it.
